channel.title: PK INDUSTRIES - Steel Plant Consumables Blog
channel.description: Practical technical articles on casting powder, nozzle filling compound, refractory castable, mortar and ladle covering compound.

item.title: Why a Ladle Does Not Open Freely, and What to Check First
item.description: Free opening rate is one of the cleanest indicators of ladle practice health. Here are the four causes behind most failures, and the order to check them in.

item.title: Applying Ladle Covering Compound: Timing, Coverage and Topping Up
item.description: Ladle covering compound only saves temperature if it forms an unbroken layer at the right moment. When to add it, how to judge coverage, and when topping up stops helping.

item.title: The First Heat-Up of a Refractory Castable, and Why Rushing It Spalls the Lining
item.description: Explosive spalling on first fire is a water problem, not a material problem. What is happening inside the lining, and how to build a heat-up schedule that survives it.

item.title: Filling the Ladle Nozzle, Step by Step
item.description: A repeatable filling procedure for the ladle well and nozzle, why the sequence matters more than the quantity, and the shortcuts that cost you a free open.

item.title: Storing and Handling Nozzle Filling Compound Without Losing Free Opening
item.description: Most free opening losses are decided in the store, not at the ladle. A practical storage and handling procedure, and the three habits that quietly undo it.
